feedback: Create one StudyPart for the methodological add-on reported elsewhere. Assign du4, mu3, and td3 to that part. Do not link this part to the German value-set outcomes, findings, or product. The study-level design can remain the default for the part. Also add a MethodUse for the “test for homoskedasticity in a Tobit regression,” with context DIRECT_CURRENT_ACTIVITY and function QUANTITATIVE_ANALYSIS. Link its evidence to Methods—Data Analysis and Modeling, paragraph 5, and associate it with the selection of mod4/f5.

Remove pur2 (MEASUREMENT_PROPERTY_EVALUATION). It duplicates and broadens the stated content-validity aim; the article did not evaluate a separate psychometric property. Keep pur1 and do not change the primary family, because content-validity evaluation remains a measurement-property study. Retain o2 and o3 as reported feasibility and method-performance outcomes. Also separate adm1 by channel: keep one Administration for face-to-face interviews and create a second for the single Zoom interview. Link su2 only to the Zoom Administration. Apply the instrument and interview methods to both Administration records, and do not infer an unreported remote setting.

Remove Purpose p2, METHOD_OR_PROTOCOL_QUALITY. The article does not state evaluation of a method or protocol as a scientific aim. Proxy-perspective use and instruction wording are part of the recorded content-validity and response-process evaluation. Keep CONTENT_VALIDITY_EVALUATION as the ranked purpose. Renumbering is optional; no other material repair is needed.

Add flat StudyParts for the separable protocol-development stages: completed online-survey piloting, completed pilot think-aloud interviews, planned additional pilot interviews, and the planned pilot focus group. Link their distinct samples and data to those parts. Record the completed survey-pilot sample as at least 17 contributors in total: at least 14 convenience respondents plus three Consumer Advisory Group members. Record the completed interview-pilot sample as two respondents. Record the planned additional interview-pilot target as six and the planned pilot focus group as one group. State the authors’ inclusion rules: the completed convenience survey and two interview pilots are excluded from the main samples; the six further interview pilots enter the final analysis only if no substantial changes occur; the pilot focus-group data are excluded. Capture the reported pilot outputs and influence, including survey and introductory-text amendments and the change that moved sensitive personal-priority discussion from focus groups to one-to-one interviews. Keep the main planned study as s1 with HEALTH_PREFERENCE_RESEARCH, PLANNED, and NO_RESULTS_YET; do not treat pilot observations as results of the planned main sample. Change sf3 and the randomized presentation conditions in sf4 to STUDIED_CONDITION. Split sf4 into separate factors for left-right display position and block order. Replace sf5 with separate StudyFactors for each analysed respondent characteristic, with source-faithful levels where reported. Scope sw1 to the Qualtrics consent questionnaire for the interview and focus-group components unless another article location establishes Qualtrics as the main PTO survey platform.

Delete scu1 as a ScoringUse because the source does not report use of a preference-based value-set product. Record the PedsQL reverse-scoring and linear-transformation procedure as a MethodUse with function MAPPING_OR_DERIVATION. Keep iu10 as the scoring input. Change mu2, the level sum score procedure, from QUANTITATIVE_ANALYSIS to MAPPING_OR_DERIVATION; it derives scores before the psychometric analyses. Replace sf4 with two StudyFactors: caregiver-reported change in general health and caregiver-reported change in main health condition. Give each factor the five source response levels: much better, somewhat better, about the same, somewhat worse, and much worse. State that responsiveness used “much better” and a pooled “somewhat worse or much worse” category. Add the reported implementation limitation that some instruments lack available country-specific value sets and that EQ-5D-Y-5L had no available value set, which limits use of the results in economic evaluation.

Keep one Study, but add a pilot-testing StudyPart and a formal valuation StudyPart. The pilot is a separable 50-participant part that tested and refined the procedures and traditional Chinese EQ-VT presentation. Link sam2, du8, si2, and the pilot-specific presentation refinement to this part. Give the pilot effective design axes of PARTICIPATORY_DESIGN, CROSS_SECTIONAL, NONCOMPARATIVE, and NOT_APPLICABLE. Link the formal recruitment, C-TTO and DCE data, valuation tasks, quality assurance, models, outcomes, findings, product, and formal administrations to the formal valuation part. Give that part the existing quantitative, cross-sectional, between-method, and not-applicable design values. Keep only uses that truly span both parts at study level. Remove sam1 or identify it only as an aggregate across the two parts. Change sam2 to COMPLETED, size 50. Keep sam3 as the formal ENROLLED sample of 1,073. Replace sam4 with an EXCLUDED formal-study sample of 73 participants who discontinued or rushed; the 50 pilot participants were not exclusions. Add a formal COMPLETED sample of 1,000 and keep the ANALYZED sample of 1,000. Link the 970-person quality-control subgroup, the 295-person matched subgroup, and the 30 flagged interviews to the formal part; state that the 30 interviews were excluded only from the sensitivity subgroup and remained in the primary model. Delete pur3. Model comparison was a procedure for selection of the value-set model, not a stated VALUATION_METHOD_EVALUATION purpose. Delete su5 and gap1. LINE was only low-importance communication software in the quality-assurance workflow, so its omission does not justify an ontology gap.

Add ProtocolUse records for the Arksey and O’Malley scoping-review framework and the Levac et al. refinements. Use DIRECT_CURRENT_ACTIVITY and GOVERNING_STUDY_PROTOCOL. Add the reported ICD-11 disease-condition categorization as a current analysis method. Keep PRISMA-ScR as the reporting guideline. No change is needed to inclusion, publication form, Study count, primary family, instruments, findings, or limitations.

Represent the current work as a secondary cross-sectional analysis of data from the previously reported feasibility study. Change du1 and du2 from CURRENT_STUDY_COLLECTION to PRIOR_RESEARCH_COLLECTION. Change the contexts of the related EQ-5D-3L, EQ-VAS, and demographic-questionnaire uses to INPUT_DATA_PROVENANCE. Record prospective convenience sampling as SOURCE_STUDY_ACTIVITY because it describes collection for the source feasibility study. Keep du3 as ROUTINE_SERVICE_COLLECTION. Add a VALUE_SET Product for the Canadian EQ-5D-3L TTO value set and link sc1 to that Product; the scoring label alone does not supply the required product relation. Also add a SourceConflict for the Methods citation: §2.1 cites reference 20 as the earlier patient-accrual manuscript, but reference 20 is the Brazilian health-inequity study, while reference 22 is the matching Ontario feasibility report. The family, purpose, models, principal findings, and limitations can remain unchanged.
